description: Know when to move on, move out and move away. Do not sabotage your life by overstaying your welcome #chooseme #designyourlife #confidence
transcript: Staying in spaces longer than necessary distorts our realities. When our brains begin to complete familiarity with alignment is when we begin to lose who we are. It is so important to keep notice and take heed of your internal voice and when it starts to get quieter. That is a problem. There is no place, person or thing worth us losing ourselves in the process. We must be willing to maneuver. We must be willing to move on and restart the process. When we do not do that, we keep ourselves stuck. When we are stuck, we are not able to move through seasons and we change who we are and we lose the essence of who we are. We must be willing to move.
